Anna — thanks, glad the demo landed. Attaching a lightweight seed doc and an acceptance matrix to get the conversation moving.

Quick summary of what I attached and what to expect in the draft:
- Lumina_MAP_seed_v1.gdoc (seed MAP, editable) — includes a 6-week timeline, owner assignments, and proposed test cases for validation. Link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1-XXXX-Lumina-MAP-seed
- acceptance-matrix.xlsx — checklist-style matrix (security, latency, data handling, accuracy gates)

Top-line proposed cadence (first-pass):
Week 0 (prep): access, contract kick, test dataset exchange
Week 1 (integration): network & infra integration, baseline run, smoke tests
Week 2 (tech validation): latency profiling, upstream routing tests, KV/prefix cache sanity checks
Week 3 (quality tests): eval set passes, human review sample, hallucination checks
Week 4 (performance tuning): batching/quantization config, cost runbook draft
Week 5 (pilot): end-to-end pilot with production traffic slice, metrics collection
Week 6 (acceptance): sign-off and close; Doc + runbook handed to Lumina ops

Proposed owners:
- Redwood tech lead: Marissa Cole (cc'd)
- Redwood SRE/ops: Jasmine Liu (cc'd)
- Redwood commercial/contact: Mina Haddad

Acceptance criteria examples (in seed doc):
- Latency: 95th <= 300ms for 512 tokens under pilot traffic profile
- Data handling: no customer PII persisted beyond KV cache TTL; audit logs enabled
- Quality: avg. eval F1 >= baseline-0.03 on agreed prompt set

Next steps I propose:
1) We'll drop comments in the seed doc by EOD Friday (Aug 21).
2) Can we do a short sync Thursday Aug 22 11:00 PDT to align owners and confirm test datasets?

Attach: Lumina_MAP_seed_v1.gdoc (Google Doc stub), acceptance-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

Thanks — sending over the sheet now.
